# New team member

Welcome! Fill in the fields below so I can add you to the team page. Only `name` and
`info` are required — leave anything you don't want listed blank.

```yaml
name:            # e.g. Jane Doe
info:            # your role, e.g. "PhD student" or "MS student"
notes:           # optional, e.g. "NSF GRFP" or "co-advised w/ ..."
email:
linkedin:
github:
website:
scholar:         # Google Scholar profile URL
researchgate:
```

## Photo

Please **attach a headshot** to this issue (drag-and-drop into the comment box). If you do not include a headshot, I will use Buzz (the GT mascot) instead.
